description.shortText: A waste bin powered by machine vision, able to read in real-time the fill-level of the container. It automatically compacts waste, thus increasing storage capacity. It could help municipalities to increase recycling, as well as reduce their carbon footprint.

attachments.name: How Solar Powered Trash Cans Might Mean Major Savings for Cities
attachments.description: The trash cans are solar powered because they dont just collect trash, they compact it. That allows each receptacle to hold about five times more waste than a non-compactor of the same size.
